text:
rachel: Starting a controlled toggle for `session_affinity_v2` tied to model v2.5 in the 03:15 UTC change window. Plan: 2% -> 10% -> 25% with 6m soak. We'll pin mobile cohorts for 25m.
tom: Acknowledge. Which cohorts exactly? want to avoid mixing old sticky sessions with new behavior.
rachel: Pin mobile cohorts m-a and m-b to v2.5 for the duration of the first 25m. others follow the ramp. run id rf12e.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled flag update `session_affinity_v2` -> 2% (target model v2.5). run rf12e. safety-mode: manual-ack between steps.
nana: (typo) ana: I'll enable extra trace sampling for mobile flows and add a KV cache monitor.
tom: Rollback plan: unpin cohorts immediately, then set flag to 0%. command ready: ```
deploy-bot toggle --flag session_affinity_v2 --value 0 --reason "rollback - threshold breach" --run rf12e
```
rachel: Good. Also prep quick-unpin: ```
rolloutctl unpin --cohorts "m-a,m-b" --run rf12e
```
ops-bot: ops-bot: safety-window set to 6m for run rf12e. paging policy attached to #incidents.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: completed step 1 -> 2% for `session_affinity_v2`. next check scheduled at 1768889288.
nana: Initial metrics: p95 +3ms, mobile session success steady, error rate unchanged. moving to 10% after soak unless thresholds hit.
tom: Keep an eye on tokenization cache pressure and sticky-session 302s. If 302s increase >0.2% roll back.
rachel: Annotated release notes: https://redwood/internal/releases/rel-2.5-affinity (run rf12e, pins, rollback commands).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: awaiting manual ack to progress to 10%.
tom: Acked, proceed.
ops-bot: ops-bot: manual ack received. advancing run rf12e to step 2.
nana: Step2 metrics after soak: p95 +8ms (expected), 302s +0.05% - within margin. no rollback.
rachel: After second soak we'll decide whether to extend pin or unpin early. If stable, plan to remove pins at end of the 25m anchor and continue roll to 50% tomorrow.
tom: Noted. If anything looks off, use the two-step rollback (unpin -> 0%). Keep channel open for 45m. :eyes:
